note: Real export shipments are confirmed by customs records, not by website claims: 17 records counted by the source, 5 rows actually visible, dated 2025-07-05 (BOL 3315960, Tuglakabad ICD -> Vladivostok, Russia, HS 62032300 / 62034300) and 2026-02-26 (BOL 1037721, Nhava Sheva -> Novorossiysk, Russia, HS 62034290). Declared HS 620323;620343 matches the observed 62032300/62034300 lines, but the actual cargo is readymade garments (men's jackets/trousers, cotton, poly/viscose/elastane), NOT food/FMCG as claimed in industry_claimed — the industry label is wrong and should be corrected to textiles/apparel; per project rules this is not a rejection ground. Note the 2026-02-26 record is the latest cargo date reported by the source. Domestic (India) supply evidence: not found, recorded as unknown/null rather than assumed. Caveat: volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403 and search engines returned no usable results, so this rests on a single free-view source; the 17-vs-5 row gap means 12 records were not individually inspected.
